meta.title: Taruu | Israel’s Public Consensus Mechanism
meta.description: Taruu is a public consensus mechanism that measures, verifies and surfaces where the majority of the public stands, from the voice of a city to the voice of a nation. Every voice is identity- and GPS-verified and sealed on the blockchain. Opening nationwide on 04.08.26.
meta.keywords: public consensus, majority opinion, direct democracy, community voting, GPS resident verification, blockchain voting, public transparency, civic participation, Israeli municipalities

hero.subtitle: Taruu helps communities form a transparent civic majority on issues that truly matter. We create an objective picture that helps authorities understand residents' wishes and act in coordination with the community.

badges.price: Voting Is Free: No Payment, No Barriers

hero.pilot: Opening nationwide on 04.08.26. Features and procedures evolve with the community.

items.title: Real Local Issues
items.description: What concerns the street and neighborhood. You decide what goes to vote and propose topics for consensus.

items.title: Verified Residents Only
items.description: Only those who live within the municipality participate and influence. GPS verification ensures the voice is local and authentic.

items.title: Transparent Results for Everyone
items.description: See the full picture in real time. No "closed rooms" - data is visible to residents and council alike.

items.title: Focused Community Dialogue
items.description: Reducing noise and verbal hostility in favor of an organized tool that creates clarity and consensus.

items.title: Full Financial Transparency
items.description: Every vote has a transparent community fund on an open ledger, financed by outside investment in the vote's BAG. Every movement is visible, from investment to impact.

steps.title: Easy Registration
steps.description: Email or phone, quick verification. That's it, you're in.

steps.title: See What's Happening (Or Propose a Topic)
steps.description: Discover active votes in your municipality, or propose a new topic you want to bring to the agenda.

steps.title: Vote and Participate
steps.description: Choose a position, verify presence (GPS), and vote. Free, with no payment and no barriers.

steps.title: Follow the Results
steps.description: Watch data in real time. Results are presented to the council as a clear, transparent, data-backed community position.

pilot.title: Opening Nationwide: Join as Partners
pilot.description: To make this tool truly accurate for us, we've created a quiet WhatsApp group where we consult on development stages, refine user experience, and think together about the first topics for voting.
